name: Runtime / Compute Environment
purpose: Represent governed runtime environments, infrastructure resources, deployed instances, configuration-control designations and temporal hosting topology without duplicating logical systems, deployment occurrences, asset records or tenant landscape facts.

owns: deployed-instance runtime identity and tombstone history
desired-versus-observed state correlation and retained drift
configuration-item designation under a named control authority
delegates: logical software-system and business-application identity to WM-SFT-002
deployment occurrence and placement outcome to WM-SFT-009
fact mastership and bounded impact projection semantics to WM-XCT-039
physical-item identity and asset evidence to WM-OBJ-001
financial asset and depreciation semantics to finance masters
excludes: a second logical Software System identity
network address as an eternal identifier
copy of financial or physical asset master
current topology represented as timeless truth
deletion or identifier reuse for ephemeral resources

relations.purpose: Resolve the logical software system or business application without copying identity.
Resolve the deployment occurrence that created or changed deployed instances.
Reuse fact-mastership desired-versus-observed and bounded impact projection rules.
Resolve an underlying physical item while preserving separate CI and asset lifecycles.

operations.effect: Create a governed runtime environment independent of its current members.
Mint a non-recycled runtime instance pinned to one artifact version.
Append a temporal topology edge with source and assertion kind.
Append desired or observed state while retaining drift.
operations.authority: declared master for the fact path

operations.effect: Place a referenced subject under configuration control for a validity period.
Close validity and retain a tombstone and succession evidence.

invariants: Every deployed instance references exactly one immutable artifact version.
Environment, resource, deployed instance and CI designation use distinct identifiers and lifecycles.
Every observation records source, method and observed, effective and recorded times as applicable.
Address or hostname change alone never changes subject identity.
Every HostingRelation has a validity interval and assertion kind.
Current topology is an as-of projection of temporal relations rather than timeless stored truth.
Identifiers are never recycled and retirement retains a tombstone.
Environment and cluster identity remain independent of member resources.
Node replacement creates new resource and instance identifiers plus explicit succession links.
Desired and observed states remain separate and drift is retained.
A CI designation does not duplicate its designated subject.
A CI designation and a financial or physical asset record never share identity.
Missing or stale observation means unknown rather than absent.
Impact answers are time-qualified and state their completeness boundary.
Environment identity is distinct from service and logical software-system identity.
